closure_rule: A finding closes only after issue-specific implementation, tests, criteria, and evidence are checked and canonical Jira source, Control database, generated views, and observed remote state are deliberately reconciled in a compatible batch.

findings.reason: Requirement implementation is evidenced, but every linked source Jira item still projects PLANNED_ONLY. Bulk source/database/generated/remote reconciliation is required before Control may treat the work as fresh implementation or the finding may close.
